title: A room, from one seat
note: Looked at from one seat with a Meta Quest 3S on 17 November 2026: 26 pictures. Nothing was walked round, so this is a view to look round from where it was photographed; away from that spot it has gaps. The 3-D model of the room is an estimate: the headset measured only the wall with the map, and the rest of the shape comes from a depth-estimating network pinned to one measured point per picture. Published by the person whose room it is; the camera pictures stay with them.
